# v0.7.1 §6 confirms that the grammar disallows non-tail effectful expressions
# as bare statements — only `let`, `commit`, and `assert` may appear as
# statements. Verify the parser rejects it, with the dedicated diagnostic
# that says how to bind it (#3161) rather than "expected `}`".
bynk.parse.bare_expression_statement
an expression cannot stand alone as a statement
